role: Activation probe: drives ItemInWorldManager.activateBlockOrUseItem (Block.onBlockActivated) the way NetHandlerPlayServer handles a C08, on a raw region scattered with every activatable block kind, with a probe-owned survival EntityPlayerMP posed per case; records the block writes, player and tile entity state per case.
notes: Output directory assumed to be out/java/activate/<name> from the native Makefile's test-data mapping (test X reads out/java/X); not checked on disk.
